prerequisites: It is recommended to have taken or be taking Statics, Machine Elements, and Material courses.

learning_outcomes.text: Defines and classifies chassis and body concepts.
Interprets the differences between chassis and body types.
Explains chassis-body materials and the properties of profiles used in chassis manufacturing.

syllabus_topics: Defining structural elements of motor vehicles (Clutches, gearboxes, braking systems, wheel suspension systems, dampers and axles)
General information: Classification of chassis and body
Vertical bending and torsion of the chassis
Aerodynamic form optimization of the body
Numerical analysis of chassis for some vehicles
Motor vehicle crash tests (on CD media)
